description: This Java class 'DefaultAuthenticationResult' implements the 'AuthenticationResult' interface, representing the outcome of an authentication process. It encapsulates headers, authorization context, and failure reasons, providing static methods for success and failure initialization, and methods to access these details.

classes.name: DefaultAuthenticationResult
classes.description: Implementation of AuthenticationResult that holds headers, authorization context, and failure reason.

methods.name: successful
methods.description: Creates a successful authentication result with given headers and authorization context.

methods.name: failed
methods.description: Creates a failed authentication result with given headers and reason for failure.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Returns true if authentication was successful (authorization context present).

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Retrieves the authorization context if available; throws exception if not.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers associated with the authentication result.

methods.name: getReasonOfFailure
methods.description: Returns the reason for failure if authentication failed; throws exception if successful.
